title: Playwright Assessment Level 1
applies_to: Output of automation scripts (sub-category SCR, Script Development): the company's Playwright Level 1 assessment is the reference for grading it (course decision). How it combines with C1-C4 and with the pass/fail model is undecided.
item_score: weight x point of the item's rating
section_score: sum(weight x point) over the rated items / sum(weight) of the rated items; a value from 1 to 5
comment_rule: A comment is required for every item rated below Meet.

items.text: Understand the locator in Playwright and use the correct one.
Controls' locators are comprehensive, robust, and good performance (in case of using xpath, xpath should be clean)
Test cases should be able to prepare and clean up test data/environment before and after the test run
Test cases can be executed in parallel (variable, data, configuration)
Scripts are well documented/commented (Test case's description, comments for steps, no spelling or grammar mistakes)
Provide enough log for debugging (e.g. log in test case, wrapper, try/catch…)
Variables, methods and classes are defined and used properly
Checkpoints are implemented properly. The results correctly reflect AUT's status, no wrong passed/failed
Test cases are well organized in corresponding test suite/folder.
Test cases use Page objects' methods instead of built-in APIs directly
Able to set up environment to develop test
Clear configuration for assets, test scripts, locators, reports, etc.
Project is well documented e.g. How to setup environment to execute single/multiple tests, serial/parallel execution, set up develop environment

level_1_expectation: Get to know Test automation and Playwright
